Hi Alex / Priya —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery: Medisync is prioritizing lower-latency inference for clinical summarization and search across your internal knowledge base; key constraints are HIPAA-safe private deployment options, predictable per-request cost, and a secure audit trail for model access.

Next step: we recommend a 60–90 minute technical deep dive where we walk through:
- Architecture fit (private vs dedicated)
- Performance profile on sample workloads (latency/cost trade-offs)
- Security & audit controls (KMS integration, audit logs)
- A short live run of a representative prompt set

Can you confirm who from your side should join (engineering, security, compliance)? We have time windows on:
- Thursday Jan 15: 10–11am PST
- Friday Jan 16: 1–2pm PST

If either works, I’ll send a calendar invite with the bridge and attach a short POC checklist + the proposed agenda. Prefer Zoom or Meet? Also flag any compliance docs you’ll want before the call.
